author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
authorised_because: F-DRIVE-1: articulation root-velocity commands do not move this robot (0.0036 m over 40 steps, 0.0000 m with rendering). BO-10 needs a trajectory, not a drivetrain model.

integration.method: explicit body-frame twist integration; body velocities rotated into the world by the CURRENT heading and applied over dt; heading wrapped to (-pi, pi]
integration.exactness: exact for straight motion, first-order for turning; the sweep is what prevents the arc between poses being stepped over

limits.acceleration_limits: NOT APPLIED in this mechanism; max_a/max_alpha are recorded in controller identity but the kinematic drive clamps velocity only

per_step_guards.purpose: a pose jump larger than the limits permit in one dt is refused as an integration fault, because that is the shape a teleport-through-a-wall would take

collision_invariant.rule: current -> candidate is admitted only if the swept footprint is free of blocking collision geometry at every sub-step
collision_invariant.queried_against: the SCENE collision geometry via PhysX, NOT the planner's occupancy map
collision_invariant.why_not_the_map: the map is what planned the route, and this programme has just established that a previous map omitted a reception desk entirely. Making it the sole protection would be a single point of failure with a known failure history.
collision_invariant.on_rejection: the pose is NOT applied; the episode stops. A guard that reported a violation and moved anyway would be a diagnostic, not an invariant
collision_invariant.footprint: the validated production footprint, radius 0.24 m
collision_invariant.resolution: the frozen swept sampling resolution from e0cce10

stall_and_completion.no_command_is_distinct_from_rejection: so 'was not asked to move' and 'was refused' never collapse

defining_controls_required.C: obstacle at the candidate pose -> rejected, pose unchanged
defining_controls_required.D: obstacle on the sweep but not the endpoint -> rejected
defining_controls_required.E: large dt cannot step over a wall -> rejected by the sweep
defining_controls_required.F: clear route -> no false rejection over 200 steps
defining_controls_required.G: zero command -> zero displacement, recorded as NO_COMMAND
defining_controls_required.H: safe non-zero command -> measurable displacement (the direction F-DRIVE-1 failed in)
defining_controls_required.I: blocked command -> realised footprint never crosses the obstacle

no_tuning_after_observation: these parameters are frozen and are not adjusted from the production trajectory
